title: Bias Vector: Mitigating Biases in Language Models with Task Arithmetic Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) by calculating Cohen's d effect sizes of cosine similarities between sentence embeddings of attribute and target word sets, specifically using the SEAT-5b dataset.
